Legislative Branch.title: House FY2024 disbursements by expense category
Legislative Branch.basis: The four House DETAIL files covering Oct. 2023-Sep. 2024 contain 499,328 transactions totaling $1,889,796,892.35. That official source universe is $73,203,107.65 below the $1.963B MTS gross-outlay control, so the gap remains visible rather than being allocated across categories.
